title: Delete a reservation assignment
description: Deletes a reservation assignment that maps a project, folder, or organization to a BigQuery reservation.

objective.narrative: When a project, folder, or organization no longer needs dedicated BigQuery slot capacity from a reservation, an administrator can delete the reservation assignment so subsequent jobs revert to on-demand pricing or inherit another assignment.
